title: Hanz has a Request

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: New Thaddeus, just the person I need to see.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: New Thaddeus, just the person I need to see.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: I’m sure you do. But learning it would take seconds, maybe even minutes out of my day, and I need all that time for my customers. You understand? Good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’m sure you do. But learning it would take seconds, maybe even minutes out of my day, and I need all that time for my customers. You understand? Good.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: The thing is, New Thadd, I have a bone to pick with you. It’s your tables.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The thing is, New Thadd, I have a bone to pick with you. It’s your tables.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: They’re offensive. My clients hate them. To quote one review: “Just looking at them made my fashion creds on ChicBeagle go down by 0.7%.”

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They’re offensive. My clients hate them. To quote one review: “Just looking at them made my fashion creds on ChicBeagle go down by 0.7%.”

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Wrong. Your tables caused my clients a moment of displeasure. Which makes them my problem. Which makes me your problem.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wrong. Your tables caused my clients a moment of displeasure. Which makes them my problem. Which makes me your problem.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Guests of the Grundown Ritz are the social cream of Nivalis. They expect to enjoy their bespoke Slum-brr-Party packages without risking their reputations.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Guests of the Grundown Ritz are the social cream of Nivalis. They expect to enjoy their bespoke Slum-brr-Party packages without risking their reputations.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Look, the LUZ is the hottest spot in Nivalis right now. Aseptic Raves, Unity Balls. And now we’re offering a full Debt Orphan Experience.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, the LUZ is the hottest spot in Nivalis right now. Aseptic Raves, Unity Balls. And now we’re offering a full Debt Orphan Experience.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: That’s business. At the Grundown we give clients what they want. And remove what they don’t.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That’s business. At the Grundown we give clients what they want. And remove what they don’t.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Invest in new tables immediately. Ones that don’t inflict emotional distress.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Invest in new tables immediately. Ones that don’t inflict emotional distress.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: They caused my clients a moment of displeasure. Which makes them unforgivable.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They caused my clients a moment of displeasure. Which makes them unforgivable.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: They’ll be tighter when your customers don't have anything to eat from.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They’ll be tighter when your customers don't have anything to eat from.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Or said tables might become the victims of… unfortunate accidents.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Or said tables might become the victims of… unfortunate accidents.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: No, I’m threatening your tables. Shall I make it clearer? “Change the tables, New Thadd, or I’ll have them kicked to splinters and thrown into the sewer”.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, I’m threatening your tables. Shall I make it clearer? “Change the tables, New Thadd, or I’ll have them kicked to splinters and thrown into the sewer”.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: I knew you had some business sense that would one day bubble to the surface. I’ll keep you on the tour itinerary. For now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I knew you had some business sense that would one day bubble to the surface. I’ll keep you on the tour itinerary. For now.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: I didn't have you down as an idiot. Don’t expect any more clients from the Grundown Ritz.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn't have you down as an idiot. Don’t expect any more clients from the Grundown Ritz.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: It allows our clients to walk the streets in Z-grade footwear… extremely vogue.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It allows our clients to walk the streets in Z-grade footwear… extremely vogue.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Look, the LUZ is the hottest spot in Nivalis right now. Aseptic still echoes, Unity Balls. And now we’re offering a full Debt Orphan Experience.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, the LUZ is the hottest spot in Nivalis right now. Aseptic still echoes, Unity Balls. And now we’re offering a full Debt Orphan Experience.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: It sells very well. That's all that matters to our elite clients.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It sells very well. That's all that matters to our elite clients.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What can I do for you, Mr Grundown?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What can I do for you, Mr Grundown?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What can I do for you, Mr Grundown?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What can I do for you, Mr Grundown?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have a name, you know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have a name, you know.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have a name, you know.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have a name, you know.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don’t…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don’t…

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What about my tables?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What about my tables?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not my clients. Not my problem.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not my clients. Not my problem.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Not my clients. Not my problem.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Not my clients. Not my problem.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have no idea what you just said.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have no idea what you just said.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have no idea what you just said.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have no idea what you just said.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: "Slum-brr-Party?"

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "Slum-brr-Party?"

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's awful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's awful.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How can I cash in on this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How can I cash in on this?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How can I cash in on this?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How can I cash in on this?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Meaning?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Meaning?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are they really that bad?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are they really that bad?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What can I do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What can I do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Lims are a little tight right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Lims are a little tight right now.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Lims are a little tight right now.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Lims are a little tight right now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Or what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Or what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you threatening me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you threatening me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That seems pretty clear. Leave it with me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That seems pretty clear. Leave it with me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That seems pretty clear. Leave it with me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That seems pretty clear. Leave it with me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Go ahead and try.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Go ahead and try.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You don't think that's a bit cynical?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't think that's a bit cynical?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You don't think that's a bit cynical?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You don't think that's a bit cynical?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You like them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You like them?
